def: Chanaan (i.e. Kenaan), the early name of Palestine

occurrences.text: Now there came a dearth over all the land of Egypt and Chanaan, and great affliction: and our fathers found no sustenance.
And when he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Chanaan, he divided their land to them by lot.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
